tex_content.html:
Corollary
[orbits of proper isometric actions are properly embedded]

Source: petersen:page-0226 ↗ prop:pet-ch5-orbit-map-differential ↗ def:pet-ch5-proper-action 1. ch5:5.6.23For a proper isometric action $H\times M\to M$ and $p\in M$, the orbit map $H/H_p\to Hp$ is a proper embedding.
Proof

↗ cor:pet-ch5-proper-action-orbit-embedding \sketch The orbit map is proper and injective. By subsection 6.4, quotienting by $\mathfrak h_p$ makes its differential injective. It is therefore a proper injective immersion, hence a proper embedding.

□
